blocks.text: An .astro page combines a frontmatter script with HTML-like markup. Frontmatter runs while Astro builds or renders the page.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Frontmatter does not automatically run in the browser. Do not put a click handler there and expect it to attach itself.
